summary: Diff adds a go-live verification checklist and updates frontend contact-link generation (phone/email/WhatsApp) to improve CTA link reliability. However, there is no evidence in the diff of an actual production Internet Computer deployment being performed/configured, nor evidence that production routes/SEO files were verified in a deployed environment.

missing_requirements.requirement: Deploy the currently approved “Draft Version 4” of the Krishna Traders website to the production Internet Computer canister(s) and perform a go-live verification pass to confirm the public site is accessible and key pages load correctly.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff only adds a manual verification checklist document and a frontend contact-link tweak; it does not include any deployment configuration/commands, canister configuration changes, CI/deploy scripts, or any recorded deployment/verification results for production accessibility, routes, or /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml availability.
